description: This Java source file defines a factory class ConnectionLoggerFactory used for creating and configuring ConnectionLogger instances related to different categories and types of connection events within a messaging monitoring system. It provides methods for generating loggers with predefined messages for use in connection, response, source, and target logging scenarios, including support for muteable loggers.

classes.name: ConnectionLoggerFactory
classes.description: A final class providing static factory methods to create ConnectionLogger instances with predefined configurations for different logging scenarios.

methods.name: newEvictingLogger
methods.description: Creates an evicting ConnectionLogger with default messages based on log category and type, storing a specified number of success and failure messages.

methods.name: newMuteableLogger
methods.description: Creates a muteable connection logger that can be toggled on or off, given a connection ID and a delegate logger.

methods.name: newSourceLogger
methods.description: Creates a source category logger with predefined success and failure messages depending on the log type.

methods.name: newTargetLogger
methods.description: Creates a target category logger with predefined success and failure messages depending on the log type.

methods.name: newResponseLogger
methods.description: Creates a response category logger with predefined success and failure messages depending on the log type.

methods.name: newConnectionLogger
methods.description: Creates a connection category logger with default configuration.
